name: How do I choose the right accessibility features for my specific needs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right accessibility features for my specific needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right features depends on individual needs, current and future mobility, and personal preferences. We recommend consulting with an occupational therapist or accessibility specialist to assess specific requirements. Our team can then translate those recommendations into practical design solutions, guiding you through material selections and product choices that best suit your situation, ensuring a safe and comfortable bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consult with an occupational therapist for specific needs; our team will guide you through design and product choices.
